Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix
Metadata.Note: Fixes corrupted textures in the game by increasing the Video Arena size, allowing the game to use more video memory for textures and effects. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more, or the game crashes. Enable either this patch or one resolution patch, never both.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 480p
Metadata.Note: Decreases game output resolution to 854x480 and increases Video Arena to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 900p
Metadata.Note: Experimental, untested 900p variant for v01.02 base PS4 mode. Uses kvicken's public community resolution-patch address layout. Enable only ONE resolution patch, including the existing 540p/720p options. Does not change the frame cap. Normalized name: Resolution Patch (1600x900). Includes Video Arena adjustment to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only one resolution patch may be enabled. Android runtime effect pending validation.

Metadata.Title: SpartanPort
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 8K
Metadata.Note: Experimental 8K render resolution (7680x4320). Uses single-sample scene buffers to leave room for textures. Uses the largest current Video Arena tier (3.98 GiB); full-game stability at 8K is not yet verified. Requires setting DMEM to 6144 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 120 FPS
Metadata.Note: Raises the engine maximum framerate from 59.94 to 120 FPS so the frametime clamp produces a 1/120 second gameplay delta. Corrects swing energy calculations to match the original 60 Hz simulation. Requires setting VBlank to 120 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken

Metadata.Title: SpartanPort
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 144 FPS
Metadata.Note: The 120 FPS patch with the engine maximum framerate at 144 FPS (frametime clamp of 1/144 second), for 144 Hz displays: with VSync every frame is shown at the original speed. Same swing energy correction. Requires setting VBlank to 144 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken, SpartanPort

Metadata.Title: SpartanPort
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 100 FPS
Metadata.Note: The 120 FPS patch with the engine maximum framerate at 100 FPS (frametime clamp of 1/100 second), for 100 Hz displays: with VSync every frame is shown at the original speed. Same swing energy correction. Requires setting VBlank to 100 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken, SpartanPort

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 240 FPS
Metadata.Note: The 120 FPS patch with the engine maximum framerate at 240 FPS (frametime clamp of 1/240 second), adapted by Felipe Prado. Same swing energy correction. Requires setting VBlank to 240 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken, gow3_pc

Metadata.Title: SpartanPort
Metadata.Name: High FPS Wall Seam Fix
Metadata.Note: Lets Kratos cross the Realm of Hades wall seam at high engine FPS: a ledge ray miss right after a hit reuses that hit. Swaps an equivalent xor encoding that SpartanPort turns into the fix. Validated on the first Realm of Hades wall at 240 FPS.
Metadata.Author: SpartanPort

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Intro
Metadata.Note: Skips the initial logos. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Any Video With X Button
Metadata.Note: Allows manual skipping of cinematics any cinematic with the X button. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Startup Black Screen
Metadata.Note: Fixes the black screen at startup with the FPS counter running: the frame pacing index starts at 2 instead of 0, so the second frame no longer waits for a flip that only it can trigger.
Metadata.Author: gow3_pc

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 540p
Metadata.Note: Experimental 540p internal render target hierarchy and output resolution for base PS4 mode, v01.02. Adapted from kvicken's resolution patches in shadps4-emu/ps4_cheats PR #145. Do not combine with another resolution patch. Performance depends on hardware; this does not change the frame cap. Normalized name: Resolution Patch (960x540). Includes Video Arena adjustment to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only one resolution patch may be enabled. Android runtime effect pending validation.
Metadata.Author: kvicken, Bachata-S4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 1080p

Enable only ONE resolution patch, including the existing 540p/720p options. Does not change the frame cap. Normalized name: Resolution Patch (1920x1080). Includes Video Arena adjustment to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only one resolution patch may be enabled. Android runtime effect pending validation. Output dimensions equal native 1080p; this option also expands Video Arena.
Metadata.Author: kvicken
